_purpose: Phase 7B. Frozen protocol: do the Phase 4-6 efficiency results for CPW-first Greeks survive deterministic volatility term structures, and must the path construction know the curve? Fixed N, reference-free (every estimator is unbiased; MSE = variance over independent scramblings). Committed before the study is run.

shapes.rising: linear from 0.6 sigma_bar to 1.4 sigma_bar over the m intervals
shapes.event: sigma_bar everywhere except interval floor(0.6 m) at 3 sigma_bar (earnings-type event)
shapes.reverting: sigma_j = sigma_bar + sigma_bar exp(-3 t_j / T): a post-shock forecast starting near 2 sigma_bar and decaying to sigma_bar

grid.note: 40 scenarios (5 shapes x 2 sigma_bar x 2 m x 2 K)

estimator: CPW-first with a volatility curve (Delta, Gamma, parallel Vega, and the m bucket vegas), all from the same points

arms.bb: Brownian bridge on the variance clock
arms.naive: constant-volatility PCA of the increments, then scaled by a_j (exact in law, ignores the curve)
arms.pca: PCA of the residual covariance (curve-aware); the baseline of all ratios
arms.gpca-trained: joint gradient-PCA rotation from 4096 gradient paths (central differences in xi), near-oracle
arms.gpca-free: training-free weighted rotation at the design point (Phase 6B construction on the variance clock)

randomisation: SciPy LMS+shift, 32 independent scramblings per (scenario, arm, N)

losses.joint: mean over (Delta, Gamma, parallel Vega) of Var_g / s_g^2
losses.bucket: mean over the m bucket vegas of Var_k / s_k^2
losses.scales: s = per-path standard deviation of the plain-MC CPW-first estimator, 2^16 independent paths per scenario

statistics: ratios to 'pca' per scenario; geometric mean over the 4 scenarios of each (m, shape); 95% percentile bootstrap (2000) resampling scramblings within each arm

hypotheses.T1: Ignoring the curve costs efficiency when the curve is not flat: naive / pca joint loss = 1 for flat (identical constructions) and > 1 with the CI above 1 for the 'event' shape at both m. Other shapes reported without a threshold.
hypotheses.T2: Greek-aware rotations keep their gain: gpca-trained / pca and gpca-free / pca joint loss <= 0.5 (geometric mean) in every (m, shape) cell.
hypotheses.T3: Training stays unnecessary: gpca-free / gpca-trained joint loss <= 1.25 (geometric mean) in every (m, shape) cell.
hypotheses.T4: The joint (Delta, Gamma, Vega) rotation also helps the bucket-vega vector, but less: gpca-trained / pca bucket loss < 1 in every (m, shape) cell, and larger than the corresponding joint-loss ratio. Reported, no threshold on the size.
